external_sources.read_scope: Abstract; §§2.1–2.3 and3.1–3.5; classification/runtime claims not transferred
external_sources.paraphrase: FRESH constructs stateless scalar mappings from uniformly sampled sequences, tests each mapping against a target, then applies dependence-aware multiple testing. Its benchmark framing is time-series classification. Marginal relevance is not a proof of conditional ranking improvement, and feature dependence correction does not itself validate p-values derived from correlated candidate/user observations.

external_sources.read_scope: number_peaks lines1140–1174; longest_strike_above/below_mean lines752–776; autocorrelation lines1769–1806; cid_ce reviewed but excluded for prior roughness overlap
external_sources.paraphrase: The implementation exposes deterministic peak-count and mean-relative run-length calculators. Autocorrelation uses centered lagged covariance divided by variance and returns NaN for near-zero variance. The proposed six-scalar bank fixes two peak supports, two run directions and two lags; this is a bounded adaptation, not the full tsfresh or FRESH procedure.

external_sources.read_scope: calculate_relevance_table signature/docs and tests dispatch; lines295–320 multipletests branch
external_sources.paraphrase: Filtering receives a feature matrix and target vector without query weights or user-cluster arguments. hypotheses_independent chooses BH versus BY correction across feature tests. Inference: this API cannot, by that choice alone, correct repeated-user/candidate-row dependence or optimize query-macro ranking. Default supervised filtering is not proposed.
Binary-target real-feature tests default to Mann–Whitney; hypotheses_independent defaults false and FDR level0.05. Default worker selection is not a local execution authorization.

external_sources.read_scope: Binary/real test functions and NaN checks, lines38–173 and246–258
external_sources.paraphrase: Binary/real tests split observations by target and call a two-sample test; NaN features are rejected. Treating masks/imputation as free or using validation to choose them would change the protocol. A learned imputer or replacement filter would require train-only fitting and a frozen transform, with grouped-observation design separately justified.
